protocol_commits.subject: Pre-specified protocol for the definition-harmonization analysis of the z~0 stellar mass functions
Protocol amendment A1: mass-scatter operator with a validation gate, added before any E1-E4 statistic was computed

Protocol amendment A2 and its implementation: galaxy-level aperture remap with Jacobian replaces level-matched shifts; synthetic tests (committed before E1, E2, E4 or any sensitivity statistic was computed)

result_first_commit.subject: v0.21.0: confirmatory run of the pre-specified harmonization analysis (not detected), generated report, site Findings section, verification chain

protocol_commits.subject: Pre-registered protocol for the parametric-versus-structural analysis of the cosmic star formation history, with its analysis code and synthetic tests (committed before any real spread, variant deviation, emulator fit, reachability distance or posterior was computed)

Protocol amendment A1 and referee fixes, committed before any outcome was computed: matched-size E3 verdict with a seed margin, common-systematic E4 with an effective-sample-size floor, V1 volume check, V4 and V5 corrections, S8 and S9, ridge as stated; power and calibration script with its output; design check kept for the record

result_first_commit.subject: v0.22.0: confirmatory run of the pre-registered parametric-versus-structural analysis (E1 funnel not detected; E3 removable by the pre-specified rule; E4 parametric; V4 for SIMBA fails marginally at 1.51 against 1.5), generated report, Findings section, release notes

protocol_commits.subject: Joint-reachability study, draft before any outcome: protocol, analysis code, synthetic-world calibration, tests, CAMELS galaxy-population summaries (2054 simulations x 5 snapshots, 186 of 530 outputs eligible), Retune page script
Joint-reachability: Amendment A1 (emulator-error correction, null-calibrated J3, mechanism classes), calibration worlds with oracle truth, site pages updated for corrected distances

result_first_commit.subject: Joint-reachability: confirmatory run (one run, protocol and A1 committed before it); joint verdict structural, D = 4.8 noise units; report and JSON

protocol_commits.subject: Pre-registered protocol: does the shape of the star-formation distribution separate TNG and SIMBA
Quenching-shape study: ingest and analysis code, synthetic tests, protocol amendment A1 (before any distance was computed)

result_first_commit.subject: Quenching-shape study: the registered run, as it came out (Q1 removable; Q2 and Q3 add nothing detectable; validations V1 and V4 do not hold)

protocol_commits.subject: Pre-registered protocol: how much does a model's published output change with resolution (ladders, metric in CAMELS noise units, labels, comparison with the TNG-SIMBA distance)

result_first_commit.subject: Resolution study: the registered run, as it came out (30 adjacent steps with a stated common box: 2 converged, 28 resolution-dependent by the rule; 16 of 19 comparable steps at least as large as the TNG-SIMBA distance), generated report and JSON
